title: Test: Python detects silent observer after 1 hour with no app traffic
description: Write test: add neighbor via DIO, advance time 1 hour, never send app traffic from that neighbor. Verify is_silent_observer==True. Then send one CoAP packet from that neighbor. Verify is_silent_observer==False. Also test: neighbor with vouch_count>0 is NOT flagged even with no app traffic. Verify: cd python && python -m pytest tests/test_silent_observer.py -x
